do.en: Check the instructor’s syllabus and assignment AI policy.
do.zh: 核对教师大纲及本次作业的AI政策。

do.en: For confidential data, use the contracted university-managed tool with web search disabled.
do.zh: 保密数据只按规定使用大学管理签约工具，并关闭网页搜索。

do.en: Use vetted, contracted platforms for non-public graduate research data.
do.zh: 非公开研究生研究数据仅使用已评估和签约的平台。

dont.en: Do not put controlled or confidential information into unauthorized AI tools.
dont.zh: 不要向未经授权的AI输入受控或保密信息。

dont.en: Do not evaluate student work with third-party detectors without a university contract or purchase order.
dont.zh: 没有大学合同或采购订单，不要用第三方检测器评估学生作品。

dont.en: Do not list AI as an author of graduate milestone work.
dont.zh: 不要将AI列为研究生里程碑作品的作者。

cl-university-of-texas-at-austin-chatgpt.text: ChatGPT EDU is listed for University of Texas at Austin in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

evidence.quote: Enterprise Technology's AI Studio lists OpenAI ChatGPT EDU as free for UT Austin students, faculty, and staff and directs users to create or access the account by signing in with their UT EID email address.

cl-university-of-texas-at-austin-claude-.text: Anthropic Claude EDU is listed for University of Texas at Austin in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

evidence.quote: Enterprise Technology lists Anthropic Claude EDU as free for UT Austin students, faculty, and staff and directs users to create or access the account by signing in with their UT EID email address; paid license tiers are separately available.

cl-university-of-texas-at-austin-gemini-.text: Google Gemini is listed for University of Texas at Austin in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

evidence.quote: Enterprise Technology lists Google Gemini as free for UT Austin students, faculty, and staff, approved only for published or non-sensitive data, with access through the user's UT Google Mail account.

cl-university-of-texas-at-austin-institu.text: UT Sage is listed for University of Texas at Austin in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

evidence.quote: UT Austin lists UT Sage as free for students and faculty, approved under UT compliance and security guidelines, and describes it as a purpose-built in-house AI tutor platform developed by the University and designed to integrate directly with Canvas.

cl-university-of-texas-at-austin-microso.text: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat is listed for University of Texas at Austin in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: allowed. Derived endorsement type: officially endorsed.

evidence.quote: Enterprise Technology lists Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat as free for UT Austin students, faculty, and staff, approved under UT compliance and security guidelines, with access by signing in through the UT Microsoft 365 account.

cl-university-of-texas-at-austin-microso.text: Microsoft 365 Copilot is listed for University of Texas at Austin in an official university AI tools source. Derived availability: conditionally allowed. Derived endorsement type: institutionally licensed or procured.

evidence.quote: Enterprise Technology lists Microsoft 365 Copilot as paid for faculty and staff. Faculty and staff can request a premium license through UT Austin's ServiceNow service catalogue for the product integrated with their Microsoft 365 environment.

claim-ut-austin-001.text: UT Austin acceptable-use guidance says published university information may be used freely with AI tools, while controlled or confidential university information can be used only with university-managed AI tools covered by contracts that protect university data and disable web search functionality.

evidence.quote: Public or Published Data: Data that is publicly available or classified as Published university information ... may be used freely with AI tools. Controlled or Confidential Data ... can be used with AI tools that are managed by the university and covered by contracts explicitly protecting university data ... and web search functionality must be disabled.
evidence.location: Allowable Use section

claim-ut-austin-002.text: UT Austin acceptable-use guidance says unauthorized AI tools are not approved for controlled or confidential university information, including student records subject to FERPA, health information, proprietary information, and other controlled or confidential data.

evidence.quote: AI tools that lack a university contract and appropriate data-sharing controls are not approved for use with Controlled or Confidential university information. This includes free or non-UT-managed versions of AI tools like ChatGPT and Copilot.
evidence.location: Prohibited Use section

claim-ut-austin-006.text: UT Austin AI detection guidance prohibits third-party AI detection software from being used to evaluate student work or assignments unless a university contract or purchase order is in place.

evidence.quote: The University prohibits the use of all third-party software, including AI Detection Software ... to evaluate student work or assignments unless a University contract or purchase order is in place.
evidence.location: Use of AI Detection Software Requires a University Contract or Purchase Order

claim-ut-austin-003.text: UT Austin acceptable-use guidance says the CISO must review AI tools before procurement, development, deployment, or use when the tools are intended to autonomously make, or be a controlling factor in making, consequential decisions.

evidence.quote: UT Austin’s CISO must review AI tools to be used for any of these purposes prior to their procurement, development, deployment, or use.
evidence.location: Prohibited Use - Heightened Scrutiny section

claim-ut-austin-004.text: UT Austin responsible-adoption guidance defines responsible AI use in teaching and learning as adopting AI in ways that facilitate learning outcomes and foster human development for campus community members.

evidence.quote: At UT Austin, we define responsible use of AI in teaching and learning as the adoption of AI that facilitates the achievement of learning outcomes and fosters human development for all members of the campus community.
evidence.location: Definition of Responsible Adoption of AI for Teaching and Learning

claim-ut-austin-007.text: UT Austin AI detection guidance says submitting student work into AI detection or other third-party software without a university contract or purchase order may violate student copyright, intellectual property, or FERPA privacy rights.

evidence.quote: Submitting student work (even if it is anonymized) into any AI Detection Software (or any other third-party software) without a University contract or purchase order in place may be a violation of that student’s copyright and intellectual property rights.
evidence.location: Student Intellectual Property and Copyright

claim-ut-austin-005.text: UT Austin responsible-adoption guidance includes academic integrity as a principle for AI use, linking responsible use to the honor code, scholarly values, ownership, and appropriate authorship of tool outputs.

evidence.quote: Academic Integrity: Use AI in alignment with our honor code and fundamental scholarly values such honesty, respect and authenticity, taking ownership and claiming authorship of the output of tools when appropriate.
evidence.location: Framework of Principles

claim-ut-austin-008.text: UT Austin graduate-education recommendations state that graduate students and mentors must use only vetted, university-contracted generative AI platforms for work involving non-public research data.

evidence.quote: Graduate students and their mentors must only use vetted, University-contracted generative AI platforms for work involving non-public research data.
evidence.location: Research, Scholarship and Creative Endeavors

claim-ut-austin-010.text: UT Austin CTL teaching-policy guidance says using generative AI tools to create course-assignment responses in a way the instructor does not accept may be considered academic dishonesty by the university.

evidence.quote: The use of generative AI tools to create responses to course assignments in a way that is unacceptable to the course instructor may be considered a case of academic dishonesty by the university.
evidence.location: Policies - Academic Honesty

claim-ut-austin-011.text: UT Austin classroom guidance recommends that instructors requiring generative AI understand and abide by UT acceptable-use guidance, identify syllabus policies clearly, and submit specific software requirements through the University Co-Op.

evidence.quote: Ensure that your syllabus clearly identifies Syllabus Policy statements regarding the use of generative AI in your class. If you plan to encourage or require the use of generative AI in your class, ensure that requirement is clearly listed in the Required Course Materials section of your syllabus.
evidence.location: Recommended Practices for Requiring the Use of Generative AI in the Classroom

claim-ut-austin-009.text: UT Austin graduate-education recommendations say students should remain accountable as the sole intellectual author of milestone work and should never cite AI as an author.

evidence.quote: Students should remain accountable as the sole intellectual author of milestone work and should never cite AI as an author.
evidence.location: Graduate Milestones
